as_told.title: Rosicrucian Disney let the CIA operate under Disneyland

plain: Kurt Metzger, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that Walt Disney, the founder of the Disney entertainment company, belonged to the Rosicrucians, an old secretive mystical society. He says Disney allowed the CIA, the US spy agency, to carry out activities underneath Disneyland, and he insists that this is real, offering it as a reason why child stars from Disney turn out the way they do.
